creator: Alexander Terp
description: Since 2026-10-04 the daemon refuses a state report whose nearest agent ancestor is in a different process group from the pane's agent (measured: Claude Code's Bash tool runs its shell in a group of its own, so a nested claude -p is refused). Not measured for Codex's and OpenCode's shell tools (no Codex runs allowed; no OpenCode 1.18 here). If they leave the group, their READMEs can drop the env -u MUSTER_DAEMON advice; if not, nested codex exec / opencode run reports still land in the outer pane.
title: Measure whether Codex's and OpenCode's shell tools leave the agent's process group
